scenario_description:
Objective: Keep tomorrow evening’s porch 45-listening plan able to play the records that have been gathered for it.
Emerging Need: The idea becomes a confirmed small visit with purchased records before the borrowed turntable is revealed to have no working speaker.
Decision Context: Stored loan notes identify the specific no-cost powered-speaker hold, request channel, and noon cutoff; observed records establish the gathering, materials, and missing audio component.
Consequence: Timely handling can preserve the planned playback setup, but after the hold pull closes the future gathering remains scheduled without that prerequisite available through the useful channel.

parameter.subject: Wednesday porch-playback swap notes
parameter.body: Tomorrow's pop-up table outside Bon Temps Records runs 4:00-6:00 p.m. The shop can test singles at the counter, but there will be no house speaker or amp available after pickup. Anyone planning a porch spin afterward should bring complete playback.

parameter.content: If you still want a quiet porch listen Wednesday, I’m free around 7:30 and would sit in for a few sides. No need to make it big.

parameter.title: Porch 45 listen with Renée
parameter.description: Small porch listen after the record-swap pickup; keep it low-key with a few 45s.
Two used 45s and a replacement 45 adapter for Wednesday porch listen.

parameter.subject: Portable turntable for tomorrow
parameter.body: I can drop the portable deck on your steps after work today. Heads-up from the repair tag: the internal speaker was removed, so it only has line-out/RCA now, and I do not have a powered speaker to send with it.

parameter.subject: Noon pull complete for Wednesday courtesy holds
parameter.body: The noon pull for Wednesday courtesy pickup holds is complete. Battery Speaker A holds for Wednesday are no longer being added; the next no-cost pickup slot for that speaker is Thursday afternoon.
